description:
## Finding
\`audit/\` directory contains:
- \`phase0_done.txt\` through \`phase4_done.txt\` (epic-run state markers)
- \`status.md\` (running coordinator log)
- \`pyc/\` (subdirectory; not inspected)

These are review-loop transient artifacts.

## Why P3
- \`AGENTS.md\` rule (review-loop instructions): \"Do not write throwaway planning files\" / \"The only permitted markdown planning artifact is a crate's PLAN.md.\"
- The \`phase*_done.txt\` files are state markers that cease to be meaningful immediately after each epic run.
- \`status.md\` is a long-running coordinator log; useful for archaeology but bloats the repo over time.

## Fix
Two coherent options:
1. Move \`audit/\` contents to \`.git/info/\` or a non-tracked location.
2. Add \`audit/\` to \`.gitignore\` and remove from history (or keep historic ones but stop tracking new ones).
3. If the audit log is intentionally a permanent record, rename \`status.md\` to \`docs/audit-log.md\` and remove the \`phase*_done.txt\` markers.

## Scope reference
\`audit/\`.
title: P3: audit/ directory contains transient phase files in committed tree
